parsed.name: ai_power_global
parsed.strategy: Bet that the AI capex bottleneck is physical, not digital: power generation, grid transformers, cables, liquid cooling and the HBM memory each GPU consumes. Every name carries a dated observable inside Oct 12-Nov 13 (GEV/VRT/NVT/MU/TSMC/ASML/Advantest earnings, Hon Hai Tech Day, Korean and European Q3 prints), so relative P&L is driven by real numbers rather than theme drift. I am wrong if a hyperscaler capex digestion headline, an HBM4 pricing cut, or a Taiwan/Korea FX or export-control shock hits the whole stack at once, since this book is one correlated factor wearing fourteen tickers.
parsed.objective: Maximise relative P&L versus the Bloomberg WLS index from 2026-10-12 to 2026-11-13 with a long-only global AI power and memory book.
